items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: St. Philip and Preah, I just now remember now. Oh yeah. That on the corner is a big two story house. That's where I was born.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. I can't have you on because I didn't even know, I haven't seen you so long ago. I didn't even know where you was at. Yeah. You know who told me where you was at? Chester Jones. Yeah, yeah, yeah. And I came around here and I went knocking the house over there and Poisey came out of his house, see. Yeah. And Poisey came out and I said, Poisey, where the devil Rogers lived at? So Poisey said, right in that back, yeah. Yeah. I came here knocking on the door.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I lived in this vicinity all my days, all my days. Born and raised right here. You know where I was born at? Where? St. Philip and Preah, I just now remember now. Oh yeah. That on the corner is a big two story house. That's where I was born. Yeah, it's opposite Vic's Grocery. Yeah. It's a bar room. It was a bar room now.

Yeah. It was a bar room now. It was a bar room now. It was a bar room now. Yeah, yeah. It was a bar room. It was a bar room. Yeah. It was a bar room. Yeah. It was Vic's Grocery. Old man Vic and Tina and Tina had a brother. Yeah. And the old man used to go hunting every weekend. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
